label: I bought a book on how to stop procrastinating. I'll start it tomorrow.
I finally got eight hours of sleep. It only took me three nights.
My bed is a magic place where I suddenly remember everything I forgot to do.
The GPS said "turn around when possible
column4:
and now I'm questioning all my life choices.
-,joy,I'm not lazy. I'm in energy-saving mode, like my phone at 20%.
-,joy,My washing machine ate another sock. At this point it's a relationship, not a malfunction.
-,joy,My fridge light is the only thing that's excited to see me every single time.
-,joy,I named my Wi-Fi Hidden Network
column5:
and my neighbors still keep trying.
-,joy,I started a band called Out of Office. We never show up, but everyone gets the message.
-,joy,Autocorrect changed on my way" to "on my whey
column6:
and now people think I'm a bodybuilder.
-,joy,My cat has stared at the same wall for ten minutes. I've never been this scared of a wall.
-,joy,I tried to be normal once. Worst two minutes of my life.
-,joy,I told my plants about my problems. Now they're dying too.
-,joy,My phone battery has outlasted every New Year's resolution I've ever made, and it's at 3%.
-,joy,I don't need a hairstylist. My pillow gives me a new look every morning.
-,surprise,Fun fact: a group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
